items.title: 4.1 Mustaqil force ka kiya kaam (work) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 4.1 with Figs. 4.1 to 4.4 (PDF 75-76).

blocks.text: Kaam (work) ko aksar jismani ya zehni mehnat ke mani mein socha jata hai. Physics mein albatta kaam ki istilah do cheezein shamil karti hai: (i) force aur (ii) displacement. Hum us saadi soorat se shuru karte hain jis mein kaam mustaqil force karti hai.

blocks.title: Mustaqil force ka kaam
blocks.text: Mustaqil force F se kheenchi jane wali cheez lein jo use force ki simt mein displacement d se hilati hai. Kaam W force F ki miqdar aur displacement d ki miqdar ke hasil-e-zarb ke taur par bayan hota hai: W = F d ... (4.1).
Equation 4.1 dikhati hai ke agar displacement sifr ho to bari force lagane par bhi koi kaam nahi hota: deewar ko dhakelna aap ke pathon ko thaka sakta hai, magar kiya gaya kaam sifr hai (Fig. 4.1).

blocks.alt: Ek larka aage jhuk kar dono haathon se ooncha deewar dhakelta hai. Deewar ke oopar Force likha teer deewar ki taraf hai; deewar par Wall likha hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 4.1: Deewar dhakelta larka (kitab ki Figure 4.1 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Jism par lagai force hamesha displacement ki simt mein nahi hoti (Fig. 4.2).

blocks.alt: Ek larka rassi se block kheenchta hai. Block shuru ki jagah A par aur phir daen taraf B par dikhaya gaya hai. Block se force ka teer F rassi ke saath ufqi (horizontal) displacement teer d se zawiya theta oopar jata hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 4.2: A se B tak kheenche block ke displacement d se zawiya theta par force F (kitab ki Figure 4.2 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Agar force F displacement d se zawiya theta banaye to kiya gaya kaam displacement ki simt mein force ke component aur displacement ki miqdar ke hasil-e-zarb ke barabar hai: W = (F cos theta) d = F d cos theta ... (4.2), ya W = F . d ... (4.3) (Fig. 4.3).

blocks.alt: Axes: F oopar aur d daen taraf. Vector F origin se d-axis ke oopar zawiya theta par shuru hota hai. Us ki nok se dashed lakeer d-axis par girti hai, aur origin se us nuqte tak d-axis ka teer F cos theta hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 4.3: Displacement d ke saath force F ka component (hissa) F cos theta (kitab ki Figure 4.3 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Force F tirchhi (at an angle) hai, is liye us ka sirf woh hissa kaam karta hai jo displacement d ki simt mein hai. F ki nok se seedhi lakeer d-axis par girayein: origin se wahan tak ka faasla F cos theta hai. Isi liye W = (F cos theta) d.
Equation 4.3 dikhati hai ke kaam scalar quantity hai. Kaam ka unit joule (J) hai; Eq. 4.1 se 1 J = 1 N m.

Jab mustaqil force faasle d tak lage to yeh waqea saade graph par bana ja sakta hai (Fig. 4.4), faasla x-axis par aur force y-axis par. Chunke force nahi badalti, graph ufqi seedhi lakeer hai. Agar mustaqil force F (newton) aur displacement d (metre) ek hi simt mein hon to kiya kaam F d (joule) hai; Fig. 4.4 ka rangeen raqba bhi F d hai, to force-displacement curve ke neeche ka raqba mustaqil force ke kiye kaam ko zahir karne ko liya ja sakta hai. Agar force displacement ki simt mein na ho to graph F cos theta aur d ke darmiyan banaya jata hai.

blocks.alt: Graph: y-axis par Force aur x-axis par distance. Rangeen mustateel (rectangle) OPQR: O origin par, P y-axis par, Q R ke oopar, R x-axis par. QR ke saath dohra teer F us ki oonchai aur neeche dohra teer d OR ki lambai dikhata hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 4.4: Mustaqil force ka force-distance graph: mustateel OPQR (kitab ki Figure 4.4 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Force nahi badalti, is liye graph seedhi ufqi lakeer PQ hai. Mustateel ka raqba (area) = oonchai x chaurai = F x d, jo kiya gaya kaam hai.

items: Agar theta 90 degrees se kam ho to kaam hota hai aur use musbat kaam kehte hain.
Agar theta = 90 degrees ho to koi kaam nahi hota.
Agar theta 90 degrees se zyada ho to kiye kaam ko manfi kehte hain.
Kaam ka SI unit N m hai, jo joule (J) kehlata hai.

blocks.caption: Kaam ka nishan
header: F aur d ke darmiyan zawiya theta

blocks.prompt: Musafir farsh se 45 degrees par strap par 200 N force se suitcase 50 m ghaseet-ta hai; kiya kaam nikalein (numerical problem 4.8). Jism 5 N force ke tahat 10 m chalta hai aur kiya kaam 25 J hai; zawiya kya hai (MCQ 4.10)?
blocks.explanation: W = F d cos theta = 200 x 50 x cos 45 = 200 x 50 x 0.707 = 7071 J, taqreeban 7 kJ. 25 = 5 x 10 x cos theta se cos theta = 0.5, to theta = 60 degrees.

items: Kaam ko force aur displacement chahiye: W = F d; zawiye par W = F d cos theta = F . d; joules mein scalar (1 J = 1 N m); displacement nahi to kaam nahi (deewar dhakelna).
90 degrees se neeche musbat, 90 par sifr, oopar manfi; force-displacement graph par lakeer ke neeche raqba kaam hai.
